caption: The drawing depicts a quilt-like arrangement composed of sixteen square blocks organized in a 4x4 grid. Each block features different symmetrical designs made up of stylized motifs, prominently using green, red, and yellow hues on a beige or off-white background. Several blocks display circular wreath patterns made of green leaves interspersed with red berries, flowers, or buds. Four blocks, placed symmetrically at the quilt's corners, each feature a stylized eagle with a yellow beak, green and yellow wings, a red body, and a yellow tail, holding arrows and a green branch. Smaller green circles and red comma-like marks accent the corners of these eagle squares. Other blocks contain intricate arrangements of floral or botanical shapes including clusters of berries, stylized stars or flowers, and arrangements of green leaves with red or yellow accents. To the upper left of the main grid, there is a small square swatch showing a close-up detail with wavy forms in yellow and red and a section of green with black dots. At the bottom of the image is the handwritten name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS."
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
